beta-blockade reduced cardiac work and cardiac efficiency during dynamic exercise in trained subjects.

the effects of beta(1)-blockade on the cardiovascular response to exercise in trained athletes.
the effects of beta-adrenergic blockade on cardiovascular function during exercise.
the effect of aerobic fitness and cardioselective beta-blocker on cardiac work during exercise.
